brief: The hiring pipeline that filled 6 roles in 30 days — every step diagrammed.

slots.title: Rapid Hiring Pipeline
slots.subtitle: How we filled six critical roles in just thirty days.
slots.check1: Removes guesswork from every hiring decision instantly
slots.check2: Creates a predictable talent pipeline on demand
slots.check3: Scales from one hire to dozens effortlessly

slots.title: Attract Top Candidates
slots.subtitle: Post where your ideal candidates already spend time online.
slots.check1: Builds a steady inbound applicant flow daily
slots.check2: Targets passive talent with precise messaging
slots.check3: Reduces cost per hire significantly over time
slots.takeawayBody: Great sourcing is eighty percent of hiring success every time.

slots.title: Screen With Criteria
slots.subtitle: Filter applications using scorecards before any interview begins.
slots.check1: Eliminates unqualified candidates within minutes flat
slots.check2: Keeps decisions objective and fully documented
slots.check3: Saves hours of manual review each week
slots.takeawayBody: Structured screening prevents bad fits from ever reaching your calendar.

slots.title: Run Fast Interviews
slots.subtitle: Conduct brief structured calls to validate skills and culture fit.
slots.check1: Respects candidate time and builds strong trust
slots.check2: Surfaces deal breakers before deep investment
slots.check3: Creates consistent experience for every single applicant
slots.takeawayBody: Short structured screens reveal more than long casual conversations do.

slots.title: Test Real Skills
slots.subtitle: Use paid trial tasks to see actual work quality firsthand.
slots.check1: Predicts on the job performance with accuracy
slots.check2: Filters candidates who talk better than perform
slots.check3: Gives finalists ownership of the hiring process
slots.takeawayBody: Paid trials attract serious talent and repel those merely browsing.

slots.title: Align The Team
slots.subtitle: Have finalists meet future peers to confirm collaboration and values.
slots.check1: Prevents costly misalignment on role expectations
slots.check2: Gives team veto power and shared ownership
slots.check3: Increases new hire retention after day one
slots.takeawayBody: Peer interviews spot culture mismatches that managers often miss completely.

slots.title: Close The Offer
slots.subtitle: Present competitive offers within 24 hours of the final conversation.
slots.check1: Captures momentum before candidates explore elsewhere
slots.check2: Demonstrates urgency and respect for their time
slots.check3: Reduces acceptance delays and counter offer risk
slots.takeawayBody: Speed in the offer stage signals a culture of decisive action.

slots.body: Use this proven 6-step system to fill your next role within weeks.
